test_title: PYST 05: SSC JE CE - General Awareness (Held on 06 Jun 2024 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements about the Rajasthan Minimum Guaranteed Income Bill 2023 is INCORRECT?

options.text: The bill promises 125 days of work a year for all families in the state.
The bill guarantees a minimum pension of ₹1,000 per month to the elderly, specially abled, widows and single women.
The minimum pension under the bill will increase by 15% every year.
The bill offers free education to all residents of Rajasthan.

solution:
The correct answer is __**the bill offers free education to all residents of Rajasthan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Option 4** is incorrect because the Rajasthan Minimum Guaranteed Income Bill 2023 does not offer free education to all residents of Rajasthan.
 
• The bill promises **125 days of work a year** for all families in the state.
 
• It guarantees a minimum pension of **₹1,000 per month** to the elderly, specially abled, widows, and single women.
 
• The minimum pension under the bill will increase by **15% every year**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Rajasthan Minimum Guaranteed Income Bill 2023 aims to ensure financial security and social welfare for the residents of Rajasthan.
 
• Such initiatives are part of broader efforts to improve the quality of life and provide a safety net for vulnerable populations.
